title: See the list of releases
statement: As a product manager, I can see every release with its version, stories and checklist progress, so I know what is being released and how far along each one is.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The Releases entry lists every release in the Saga, and each row shows its version, its story count and how many checklist steps are checked.
`release list` reports the same releases and the same counts as the reader, and `--json` returns them as data.
